elements_selected.content: All eight chip hues in `.transclusion-panel` (#f472b6 #60a5fa #34d399 #fbbf24 #a78bfa #fb923c #2dd4bf #f87171) fail WCAG 2.1 AA against white — measured contrast 1.67:1 to 2.77:1 vs a 4.5:1 minimum. Chip text colour is applied inline in src/web/build.rs:1022 and src/web/routes.rs:719. Either darken the text palette to AA-compliant variants (e.g. Tailwind *-700 shades), add a subtle filled pill background, or move colour to the left border only and use a single accessible text colour.
